annotation.text: Transaction Manager - Acquire Object Lock - Get Process List - Get Transaction Batch - Process Batch - Iterate Batch (+Pause)

DO NOT TERMINATE PROCESS MANUALLY
GRACEFULLY TERMINATE BY SETTING: cons!TM_ENABLED = false
Starting the next process immediately helps to negate a gap when transaction manager is not running for up-to 5 minutes
there may be a batch to start before we release the lock
